summary: Builds an Idle/Walk/Run blend tree plus Jump and Hang/Climb from a folder of clips.
overview: Point it at a folder of AnimationClips, or an object with clips as sub-assets such as an imported FBX, and it builds a basic locomotion Animator Controller — matching clips by name with a case-insensitive substring test, so an imported set usually needs no renaming.
useCases: Getting a working controller from a freshly imported animation set.
Rebuilding a controller after the clip set changes.
Skipping the manual blend-tree setup while prototyping.

gotchas.title: Name matching is a substring test
gotchas.body: A clip called "WalkBackwards" matches "walk". Check what it picked before assuming the blend tree is right.

gotchas.title: It generates a basic controller, not a finished one
gotchas.body: Thresholds, transitions and exit times are a starting point. It saves the tedious part, not the tuning.
